sourceReferences.title: Existential and locative constructions in Mandarin Chinese
sourceReferences.locator: Abstract, lines 20: distinguishes existential Ø V DP from locative PlaceP V DP and describes the location phrase as optional in the former, obligatory in the latter.
sourceReferences.observation: Directly supports distinguishing existential and locative constructions and their word orders. It does not support the Spanish one-to-many translation chart or all examples in this entry.

sourceReferences.title: 中国語 文法 02.05.1 存在の“有”：解説
sourceReferences.locator: Lines 17–40 and 76–79: locative 有 pattern and indefinite/unknown postverbal existence; contrasts ownership.
sourceReferences.observation: Supports a narrow Mandarin existential 有 pattern. It does not by itself validate every Spanish equivalence or all 在/是 contrasts in the entry.

sourceReferences.title: 中国語 文法 所在の“在”：解説
sourceReferences.locator: Line 33: 有 with indefinite object vs 在 clause with definite subject; example 他在屋子里.
sourceReferences.observation: Directly contrasts 有 and 在 in a defined locative context; Spanish transfer claims and remaining examples are unverified.
